book.name: Márkosarini
book.title: Márkosarini kuku Nuw Márkosi yuwaa Isus tayaspatarangu anoo kamanchintspa

content: Minootssha kamanchintspa; yuwaa Násaretshuch tputs Isusoo nda kis mazinarangusin, Isussha nllitaritap tsap tayaspatamaam naatarangu anootsi
Ashiri Kapárnáwash anush tsapoo kasayaru, Isus wipunashpat kanapurangu, yaptam kanungarangu ambtam naatarangiya. Anush Násaretush kuseeru,
zari sápatush Isus Utaáshuchish shaniyshini pshtuyaru tayaspatarangiya. Tputssha: ¿Tamaru ashiru tsiyatka? ¿Tamayarishta yasaya? ¿Tamaru tputsee yarka, tputsee ichiyzata ashka? tárangana.

¿Ndusha in tputs nishuch? ¿Ndusha panguspan ini? ¿Ndusha Mariy wip? tárangana. ¿Ndusha Sandeek' zoonll, misha Ustam zoonll, misha Utaástam zoonll, misha Simotam zoonll? tárangana. ¿Wizar iyash taakanawa? tárangana. Atusin, Isusoo natstarangusin, natsaranganaya. Isusoo kuk kaapa nda mazinarangana.

Itaru, Isussha: Siy uru tsiyatssee kis payuksa. Apanllee kuk kamanimapan waanshuchpata tputs, misha zoonllpatatam uru nda kis mazinakana, átssa. Ashirucha, siy nuwaa ashkitampasa nda mazinamaam zandaksa, tárangiya.
Tputssha mang' tatumaam ngatarangana; ashirucha Isus tputsee zapan yaramaam pinasarangiya. Tputsimun uwee wayayaru, machin yararangiya.
Ashiri Isussha: ¿Tamashta nda mangoonkana? táyaru, kasayaranllu, minush zar minupsha yakat tayaspatat minush zar minupsha yakat tayaspatat ashirangiya.

Isus wipunashinandsha 12 kuruzeeru, shaniyeersin, Isussha; Siysa tsimbun ipuneerus piyam naaku, piyam naaku shintsa, tárangu. Wizpuriri siyaam panachintspa tárangu. Siyamari yashingoo kasichpasa, mang, tárangiya.

Naakchus, maacheetsi yarintspa; tushuwshimtis yángtsa. Itaru, pangaa, misha tsingasheetstamtis yarintspa. K'tunaris minamari k'tuntayarus, spatayarus naangtsa. Kurikireetsis kichpushis pshtayarus yarintspa, tárangiya.
Tputsush pang' kuskachus, anshuri taangtsa; tárangu.
Yaktash kuskachus, itaru nda tputs kayunu taayani átu, natsaku, siyaa mazinamaam ngatku, ashiriya wanimaam kutsis káchingayarus naangtsa, Isus tárangiya, manga.
Wipunashsha ayu atusin, mang naataranganaya. Yaktash kuskamchusin tayaspatarangana. Mangishis itsinsayashtis chinangtsa; yutaritshishee ksangtsa; tárangana.
Yashingoo zapan tashitungarangitamana. Mishat, kas yutamaa wayungunpa taparayarusin yararangtamana. Ashirangsincha. Ashiri yuwaa Isus wipunashee kamachtarangu anoo kamaneena.
Mishat, yuwaa tputs Isusoo yasamaam pinasarangana anoo kamanchintspa

Anpurtam Herodesarini, Galileyshuch urkari, tsiyatssee Isusumun mazinarangiya. Watam tputs Isusoo tsiyatat tsiyatat ashiranganawa. Ashpatam tputs: Wangarineezuwa ichumampani; Isusoo, tárangana. Wangarineetsini pacharangana na támeenllparee; anparee. Ashirupa tputsee yarkiya; tárangana, manga.
Itaru, ashpatam: Elíyasazuwa yusur kuseenlliwa mang, tárangana. Mishat, ashpatam: Apanllee kuk kamanimapan, ¿zitaminarini ndusha támeenll? anparee, mang ántangat ashirangana.
Herodesarinsha tsiyatssee Isusumun mazinayaru mang: Wangarineetsi kamachtaranguri, muchoo tururangana. ¿Anuzuwa, támeeshinuwa? anparee, tárangiya.

Sirú Wangarini Herodesarinee nambarangu, ¿Mayaamsha zuwanlleetsish, Felipeets wizanll isuwarangsha shiya? An yutarita; tárangiya Herodesarineetsi. Anumandsha Herodesarinsha Wangarinee putayaru, tumanarangiya. Tumaneeru, kateenpat kamuriyaru, kasarangiya.
Herodesarinsha wizanll Wangarineetsi natsarangiya. Pachamaam kamachtamaam zandarangu, itaru xapoorangshita.

Herodesarini Wangarineets chinamana chinarangiya. Herodesarini: Wang wanasircha. Yutarit taakeeja; pachamaam watsta tárangiya. Wangarinsha tumanshishush tayaspataku Herodesarinsha: ¿Tamaru tayaspataka? tárangiya. Itaru, tayaspataku, kis mazinarangiya.

Kis mazinarangitaa, ashiritaa wizanll Wangaa pachamaam zandarangiya. Minushsha zari, yap nda chinakich amb Wangarineetsi tupchamaam kamachtarangiya. Herodesarinisha yuw nllurtarangu an masachirini tatsamkachu, tputsee zapani kuruzurangiya. Kurakaa misha komandanteetstam, misha Galileyshucheetstam wirakuch zapan kuruzurangiya. Naanints, shaniyeeruni katungeeni; zamamteeni; tárangiya.

Anushsha wizanll wip pshtuyaru, michitchitat ashirangiya. Herodesarini wamkurpa kis napataranll ashirangana. Herodesarinsha kamasinaa: Nuwaa mashamaam zandkush mashangandama nuwaatsi, tárangiya. Yuwaa zandkish anoo panachinllpa, tárangu.
Zurkuri atina. Aparimunich sura atina. Ngichkeezi. Shiy mashkachush, uru panachparina. Zandkush, nuwaanaatsi tsapunee tapuseerunll panachinllpa; ashtachinllpa, tárangiya.
Kamasinsha shitungeeru wanireetsi: ¿Nuw mayaatsi mashchi? táyaru, wanirsha: Wang muchoo, ichumampani mashangcha muchootsi, tárangiya.
Kamasinsha mikeeru kurakush pshtuyaru, Naturi Wangaa much ichumampani panangandama. Paratush pshtayarush panangandama, tárangiya.
Ashiri Herodesarinsha mang' kizpur mantsarangiya. Itaru, wamkur napanapawu Herodesarinsha pazirangiya. Dancha, watsta támaam mbamatarangiya, watam: Yuw zandkish anoo panachinllpa, táranguwa.
Sundarootsshat: Wangaa muchoo turushini; tárangiya. Tumanshishish pshtuyaru, Wangarineetsi much tururangiya.
Sheeru, paratush pshtayashinu, Neewa táyaru, kamasinaam panarangiya. Uwsha yáyaru, wanireem panarangiya Wangarineetsi muchu.
Wipunashsha tsiyatssee mazinayarusin, naayarandsin, kuseersin, Wangarineetsi tsiparee yáyarandsin, mapshiship kawineerangana. Ashiri Wangarineetsi watamcha tsiyatssi.
Mishat, yuwaa Isus tputsee kuwiz m'cheeru milo martarangu anoo kamanchintspa
Ashiriya, minushsha zari Isus táyaspatashsha kanapeeshinusin, Isusush shaniyarangusin, Apanllee kuk kamantayashinusin, Isusoo ichinguru kamaniramchinllina.
Mishat, anshutam tputssha zapan kusatarangsin, kanusamaam xararangana. Katungamaam xararangitamta. Ashiri natam Isussha wipunashee: Pzaya; yaanita naayani yap tputs ndunari ambi, tárangu,
Isuspa kanush zaruyarusin, arachich kítarangana. Yap tputs ndunari ambi naatarangana.
Naakchusin, tputs zapan natstayarusin, wingumun iriputaranll ashirangana. Minshuch yakat shitungku piyamsha yakat minshuch shitungku, sheerandsin, ichingurusin wasina yamazarsin kusarangana.
Isus mataykamchusin, káreeramchusin, tputsee zapan parangiya. Opeeja ashiru masaru taaru parangiya; yuw ksutamapan ndunpaz ashiru an parangiya.
Isus tputsee zapan pakeeru, nayanirangu, tayaspatat tayaspatat ashirangiya.

Ashiri tayaspataku zar manginamun xameekamchu, Isussha wipunash: Tputsee zanganingcha katungtseema. Papcha, tapeekachpa; mang, tárangana Isusootsi. Nish upusap wanindaja. Ashiri ashpatam yaktap naakchusin, ashpatam tputsip mazari naakchusin, katungtsee pangachpasinaya. Sheersin katungchinllinaya, tárangana.
Isussha: Nduni; nishuri maritangtsa siya; tákchu, wipunashsha: Tputsinaarich minamta masach kurikeem tarawaztayaruch, ¿tamaree ashpam tatsamooch? pshataru pishtachparee, tárangana.
Isussha: ¿Wanipa pang taar? Napangints; tárangu, wipunashsha pakeersin, Pang kuwiz m'cheeru taariya. Kayupichsha tsimbunund taaritamta, tárangiya.
Itaru, Isussha tputsee kamachtarangu; Piyam kuxinta piyam kuxinta shingtsa chirichirimuna, táyaru,
tputssha 50 kuxinta 50 kuxinta 100 kuxinta ashirangana.

Sheeru, mang pangaa yáyaru, kayupcheetstam yáyaru, íwarsha kanindap naparangu, Apaa, wapparee; mang, tárangiya. Táyaru, pangaa tupta tupta tupta sheeru, wipunasheem panarangiya. Kayupcheetssha tatapta tatapta sheeru, wipunasheem panarangitamta. Na siysa tputseem pana pana shingints; tárangiya.
Panayashtisin katungeersin, mang tazazartarangana. Wipunashsha 12 tsumb katuchimaa mang yarangana.
Kamuzananda zameetpata mil katungarangana. Ashiri yuwaa Isus tputsee kuwiz m'cheeru milo martarangu anoo kamaneena.
Mishat, yuwaa Isus kungumun naataru anoo kamanchintspa

Natumatamcha Isus wipunasheetssha: Botish zaruyarus, arachich kiteerus, Betsáyanap wasina naatstsa; tárangu, wipunashsha kanush zaruyarandsin naataranganaya. Naatarangsin, Isus tputseetssha: Pangipis kanaputantsa, tárangiya.
Isus machip kárirangiya Waparpat tsiyatamaama.
Tapitaranllu, wipunash musush upusanand kchungatan ashirangana. Isussha urupunguri waanitari taarangiya.

Kambusur kizpur kambustarangiya. Shipanung kambusur tap ashirangiya. Isussha wipunashi kizpur kchung kup kup shitar ashirangana punirustambatssin. Kiyung kachiyaranganaya. Isussha sitkachu naatarangiya. Kungumuna naantach ashirangiya. Wipunashingaz naatarangiya. Itaru, imarutachu parangana.
Isusoo kungumuna naantachu parangana. Ay sitatstee; tárangana. ¿Chaka ashtar? Kanizparee, tárangana Isusootsi.
Wipunash ichingurusin parangana. Kizpur punirangana. Isussha: Puniriyspa, nuwtanda. Isustana. Mapiyngtsa; tárangiya.

Táyaru, wipunashish wanurishsha zarukamchu, kambusuru zanay ashirangiya. Wipunashsha nda izuurasha Isusoo mangoonarangsin, mang' zuu ashiranganaya. Napa: Isus zameetpa tputs milo maritarangitaa, ashiritaa wipunashsha nda mangoonarangana. Mang' ndunarpaz ashirangana.
Ashiriya, minush zari yusur musaatssha kíteersin, tsap Kinísaritash sura anush matayarangana.
Káreeranlltisin, tputs Isusoo natstayarusin, Isus piytanda, táta táta ashirangana.
Kas yutamaa wayanllamarish kuyarandsin, Isusush yaraani atusin, Isusupsha yushindarangana. Uwsha Isus kas yutamaa yararangiya.

Yapiri Isus xiyrangu ambtam tachitarangana. Yaktap naaku, chapungup naaku, ipuspita naaku, ambtam tachitarangana. Uru paxanxshishush kas yutamaa wayarangitamanaya. Kas yutamsha: Isusoo, shiyaa kamareetstaatish patatkachuri, nuwaa yarachpasha, tárangana. Táyarusin, Isusootssha wamaree patateersin yararanganaya. Ashiri yuwaa Isus kungumun naatarangu anoo kamaneena.

footnotes.text: 1 Utaáchich kuraka 22.17; Esekiyela 34.5 tsiyatsis nipta tatsamooru taaritamta.
